paragraphs: (Sometimes Rabbi Chanan or Chanin ben Pazi.) He is mentioned many times in the Midrashim: as in Bereshit Rabbah 67:10 and 70:17, Shemot Rabbah, end of chapter 40, and Tanchuma, Lekh Lekha 26 and Vayera 18, as Rabbi Chanina ben Pazi; in Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1 and Midrash Tehillim 92:12 as Rabbi Chanan ben Pazi; and in Vayikra Rabbah 25:6 as Rabbi Chanin ben Pazi. In Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:3, Rabbi Chananyah ben Pazi raised an objection to Rabbi Chelbi; Hyman therefore places him approximately in the fourth generation of Palestinian Amoraim.

notes.text: The approximate fourth-generation placement is Hyman’s inference. Chanina/Chanan/Chanin/Chananyah and the various Midrash locators remain meaningful variants.

The consulted Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1 directly names Chanan ben Pazi. Hyman’s Chanina/Chanan/Chanin/Chananyah alternatives and approximate generation remain occurrence-specific reports, without identity merger.
